svg.title: LinuxONE 5 in two of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Designed for 99.999999% availability: IBM’s design figure for LinuxONE 5. One LinuxONE Emperor 5 (Max136) ran the same containerized workload that needed 23 compared x86 servers, in IBM’s internal tests. The drawing shows one frame beside 23 small servers. IBM internal performance tests: an IBM Machine Type 9175 Max136 with 136 configurable processor units against an x86 solution of servers with two 5th gen Intel Xeon Platinum 8592+ processors and 64 cores per CPU, running a containerized OLTP WebSphere Liberty v25 application and EDB Postgres for Kubernetes v1.25 on Red Hat OpenShift 4.17, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.5 and KVM. Results were extrapolated to a typical customer IT solution with production and non-production environments. IBM says results may vary.
